paragraphs: R. Chanina ben Antigonos, the priest.

(a) In the Mishnah: Sheviit 6:3; Eruvin 4:8; Yevamot 13:2; Kiddushin 4:5; Bekhorot 6:3, 4, 10, 11 and 7:2, 5; Arakhin 2:4; Temurah 6:5; Niddah 8:2. Also Eruvin 49b; Bekhorot 40b, 43b. There, 38b, has Chananyah.

(b) In the Tosefta he said, “I used to know those who played [the flute; source בחלל].” Bekhorot, Ad Kamma, 30b: R. Yehudah and R. Yosi were uncertain about a matter of purity. The rabbis sent to R. Chanina ben Antigonos's son, who kept watch over pure things, etc. Rashi explains: R. Chanina ben Antigonos was a priest. Rambam forgot to mention him among the priests. He lived in R. Akiva's and R. Yishmael's time. In HaMappelet, Niddah 23, he said, “R. Meir's words appear correct.” Another version has R. Chanina ben Gamliel saying this. A colleague of R. Yochanan ben Zakkai—this requires investigation. Shmuel, in his name. In R. Elazar Chisma's name: Tosefta Temurah, chapter 4.
